definitions.explanation: Proceeding forward in a straight line without turning; used especially in traffic and navigation contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直進|ちょくしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直進|ちょくしん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please go straight through the intersection.

examples.japanese: {直進|ちょくしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧だ。

notes:
{直進|ちょくしん} means to proceed forward in a straight line without turning. Primarily used in traffic, navigation, and giving directions.

TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive) — the vehicle or person goes straight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直進|ちょくしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go straight
- {直進|ちょくしん}⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧: through lane
- {直進|ちょくしん}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no through traffic
- {直進|ちょくしん}⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧: straight-through traffic has priority

TRAFFIC DIRECTION SET:
- ⟦{左折|させつ}→左折：09218_sasetsu⟧: turn left
- {直進|ちょくしん}: go straight (this word)
- ⟦{右折|うせつ}→右折：09217_usetsu⟧: turn right
- Uターン: U-turn

USAGE:
Often seen on road signs, in GPS navigation instructions, and driving test materials. Also used figuratively to mean pursuing a goal without deviation.
